svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Absent mechanisms — a refresh token, a server session, frontend JWT decoding — are named in a note, never drawn as implemented steps.
This internal flow underlies every protected endpoint already documented in the Expense, Budget, Income, Charts, Bills and Report modules.
